description_en: This API retrieves the progress details of a data migration or data synchronization task
description_zh: 本接口用于查询数据迁移或数据同步任务的进度信息
name: DescribeProjectProgress

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移或数据同步任务的 ID
parameters.name: id

Advice.description_en: The legacy advice. This field is deprecated. Use `ErrorDetail.Proposal` instead

Code.description_en: The legacy error code. This field is deprecated. Use `ErrorDetail.Code` instead

Cost.description_en: The request processing time, in seconds

AlarmLevel.description_en: The alarm level. Valid values are `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`, and `IGNORE`
AlarmLevel.description_zh: 告警保障等级，包括 HIGH（高保护状态）、MEDIUM（中保护状态）、LOW（低保护状态）和 IGNORE（无保护状态）
AlarmLevel.title_zh: 告警保障等级 (HIGH: 高保护状态, MEDIUM: 中保护状态, LOW: 低保护状态, IGNORE: 无保护状态)

CurrentStep.description_en: The current step of the project. Valid values are `PRE_CHECK`, `TRANSFER_PRECHECK`, `PREPARE`, `STRUCT_TRANSFER`, `STRUCT_MIGRATION`, `INDEX_MIGRATION`, `INDEX_TRANSFER`, `STRUCT_SYNC`, `FULL_MIGRATION`, `FULL_TRANSFER`, `APP_SWITCH`, `TRANSFER_APP_SWITCH`, `REVERSE_INCR_SYNC`, `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER`, `FULL_VALIDATION`, `FULL_VERIFIER`, `INCR_LOG_PULL`, `TRANSFER_INCR_LOG_PULL`, `INCR_SYNC`, `INCR_TRANSFER`, `INCR_VERIFIER`, `SYNC_PREPARE`, `TRANSFER_PREPARE`, `SYNC_INCR_LOG_PULL`, `CONNECTOR_FULL_SYNC`, and `CONNECTOR_INCR_SYNC`
CurrentStep.description_zh: 当前任务运行所处的步骤（PRE_CHECK, TRANSFER_PRECHECK, PREPARE, STRUCT_TRANSFER, STRUCT_MIGRATION, INDEX_MIGRATION, INDEX_TRANSFER, STRUCT_SYNC, FULL_MIGRATION, FULL_TRANSFER, APP_SWITCH, TRANSFER_APP_SWITCH, REVERSE_INCR_SYNC, REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER, FULL_VALIDATION, FULL_VERIFIER, INCR_LOG_PULL, TRANSFER_INCR_LOG_PULL, INCR_SYNC, INCR_TRANSFER, INCR_VERIFIER, SYNC_PREPARE, TRANSFER_PREPARE, SYNC_INCR_LOG_PULL, CONNECTOR_FULL_SYNC, CONNECTOR_INCR_SYNC）
CurrentStep.title_zh: 当前进行到哪一步 (PRE_CHECK, TRANSFER_PRECHECK, PREPARE, STRUCT_TRANSFER, STRUCT_MIGRATION, INDEX_MIGRATION, INDEX_TRANSFER, STRUCT_SYNC, FULL_MIGRATION, FULL_TRANSFER, APP_SWITCH, TRANSFER_APP_SWITCH, REVERSE_INCR_SYNC, REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER, FULL_VALIDATION, FULL_VERIFIER, INCR_LOG_PULL, TRANSFER_INCR_LOG_PULL, INCR_SYNC, INCR_TRANSFER, INCR_VERIFIER, SYNC_PREPARE, TRANSFER_PREPARE, SYNC_INCR_LOG_PULL, CONNECTOR_FULL_SYNC, CONNECTOR_INCR_SYNC)

EnableFullTransfer.description_en: Specifies whether full data transfer is enabled

EnableIncrSync.description_en: Specifies whether forward incremental synchronization is enabled

EnableReverseIncrTransfer.description_en: Specifies whether reverse incremental synchronization is enabled

EnableStructTransfer.description_en: Specifies whether structure transfer is enabled

FullTransferProgress.description_en: The full data transfer progress, as a percentage (from 0 to 100)
FullTransferProgress.description_zh: 全量传输进度的百分比，取值范围为 0~100

IncrSyncCheckpoint.description_en: The forward incremental checkpoint. If the source is a DB2 LUW, OceanBase, MySQL, or Oracle database, this value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
IncrSyncCheckpoint.description_zh: 正向增量同步位点。当源端为 DB2 LUW、OceanBase、MySQL 或 Oracle 数据库时，格式均为 Unix timestamp，单位为秒

ReverseIncrTransferCheckpoint.description_en: The reverse incremental checkpoint. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
ReverseIncrTransferCheckpoint.description_zh: 反向增量同步位点。格式为 Unix timestamp，单位为秒
ReverseIncrTransferCheckpoint.title_zh: 反向增量同步位点，unix timestamp，单位秒

Status.description_en: The project status. Valid values are `INIT`, `RUNNING`, `SUSPEND`, `FAILED`, `FINISHED`, `RELEASING`, `RELEASED`, `DELETED`, `RUNNING_MODIFYING`, and `RUNNING_MERGING`
Status.description_zh: 任务的状态，包括 INIT（未启动）、RUNNING（运行中）、SUSPEND（已暂停）、FAILED（已失败）、FINISHED（已完成）、RELEASING（释放中）、RELEASED（已释放）、DELETED（已删除）、RUNNING_MODIFYING（修改中）和 RUNNING_MERGING
Status.title_zh: 通用的项目状态枚举 (INIT: 未启动, RUNNING: 运行中, SUSPEND: 暂停中, FAILED: 已失败, FINISHED: 已完成, RELEASING: 释放中, RELEASED: 已释放, DELETED: 已删除, RUNNING_MODIFYING: 修改中, RUNNING_MERGING: 合并中)

StructTransferProgress.description_en: The structure transfer progress, as a percentage (from 0 to 100)
StructTransferProgress.description_zh: 结构传输进度的百分比，取值范围为 0~100

ErrorDetail.description_en: Details of the error. This field is returned only if the API call fails

additionalProperties.description_en: The value for a placeholder in the `Message` field
additionalProperties.description_zh: 用于填充 Message 中的占位符

ExtraContext.description_en: Key-value pairs for the placeholders in the `Message` field
ExtraContext.description_zh: 用于填充 Message 中的占位符

Level.description_en: The error level. Valid values are `FATAL`, `ERROR`, `WARNING`, and `CRITICAL`
Level.description_zh: 错误等级，包括 FATAL、ERROR、WARNING 和 CRITICAL

additionalProperties.description_en: The parameter value for a placeholder in the message template identified by `MessageMcmsKey`
additionalProperties.description_zh: 用于填充 MessageMcmsKey 中的占位符

MessageMcmsContext.description_en: The parameters for the placeholders in the message template identified by `MessageMcmsKey`
MessageMcmsContext.description_zh: 用于填充 MessageMcmsKey 中的占位符

MessageMcmsKey.description_en: The key for the error message

additionalProperties.description_en: A value within the context for the suggested solution

ProposalMcmsContext.description_en: The context for the suggested solution

ProposalMcmsKey.description_en: The key for the suggested solution

additionalProperties.description_en: A value within the context for the error reason

ReasonMcmsContext.description_en: The context for the error reason

ReasonMcmsKey.description_en: The key for the error reason

UpstreamErrorDetail.description_en: The details of an error from an upstream service, used for handling HTTP requests
UpstreamErrorDetail.description_zh: 上游错误详情，用于处理 HTTP 请求

Message.description_en: The legacy error message. This field is deprecated. Use `ErrorDetail.Message` instead

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. This field is returned for paginated queries
PageNumber.description_zh: 页序号，分页查询时生效

PageSize.description_en: The page size. This field is returned for paginated queries
PageSize.description_zh: 页大小，分页查询时生效

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful

TotalCount.description_en: The total count. This field is returned for paginated queries
